description: Jarvis described the Aug 11 Chris Gannett recording as a 'breakfast' based on the UTC timestamp (11:42 UTC = 6:42 AM CDT). David corrected: it was a lunch, not breakfast. The UTC-to-local conversion was wrong or the Plaud create_time reflects upload time rather than recording start time.
correction: David corrected: 'Nope. You didn't look at the time correctly. It's not breakfast at all, it's lunch'
systemic_fix: Do not infer meal type from Plaud create_time. Plaud timestamps may reflect upload or processing time, not the actual recording start. Infer meal context from transcript content or calendar only.
